record.question: Which among the following is not a ground of dissolution of marriage?
options: The respondent has been incurably of unsound mind for a continuous period of not less than three years immediately preceding the presentation of the petition

The respondent has treated the petitioner with such cruelty as to cause a reasonable apprehension in the mind of the petitioner that it would be harmful or injurious for the petitioner to live with the respondent
The respondent is suffering from epilepsy.
